description: This file defines the public API for pin control drivers in the Zephyr RTOS, including structures, macros, and function prototypes for managing pin states and configurations.

methods.name: pinctrl_lookup_state
methods.description: Finds a pinctrl state configuration by its ID within a device configuration.

methods.name: pinctrl_configure_pins
methods.description: Configures a set of pins according to the specified configuration.

methods.name: pinctrl_apply_state
methods.description: Applies a pinctrl state by its ID from a device configuration.

methods.name: pinctrl_apply_state_direct
methods.description: Applies a pinctrl state directly from a state structure.

methods.name: pinctrl_update_states
methods.description: Updates the set of states for a pinctrl device configuration.
